tasks.label: Confirm access the right way
tasks.doTxt: Get a separate user ID on Tally/Zoho. Note what access was given, by whom, on what date.
tasks.dont: Never take passwords on WhatsApp or personal chat.

tasks.label: Day-1 health check before any entry
tasks.doTxt: Check opening balances against the last closed year. List pending months of bank reco and unfiled returns.
tasks.dont: Do not start entries before this check — old errors will look like yours.

tasks.label: Collect and file source documents
tasks.doTxt: Get purchase invoices, sales invoices, bank statements and expense bills, month-wise.
tasks.reconcile: Documents received ↔ the papers list the client confirmed on the portal

tasks.label: Post purchases
tasks.doTxt: Enter every purchase from the vendor bill — correct ledger, correct GST treatment.
tasks.dont: No entry without a bill. Never dump items into 'Miscellaneous'.

tasks.label: Post sales with invoice serial control
tasks.doTxt: Enter sales serial-wise from the invoice register. Flag missing or duplicate invoice numbers to the client.
tasks.reconcile: Sales in books ↔ e-invoice portal / GSTR-1 filings, and bank credits

tasks.label: Post expenses & payments
tasks.doTxt: Book expenses with supporting bills. Move personal spends to drawings/capital.
tasks.dont: Do not guess a ledger — park unclear items in a numbered query list and ask in one batch.

tasks.label: Record cash transactions
tasks.doTxt: Update the cash book date-wise. Verify cash never goes negative on any date.
tasks.reconcile: Cash book ↔ physical cash count, same day

tasks.label: Month-end adjustment entries
tasks.doTxt: Book prepaid expenses, outstanding expenses, accrued income and depreciation for the month.
tasks.dont: Do not leave adjustments for year-end — monthly books must stand on their own.

tasks.label: Bank reconciliation — every account, every month
tasks.doTxt: Match every bank line. Prepare BRS with each difference explained in writing.
tasks.dont: Do not carry unexplained differences forward.
tasks.reconcile: Bank book ↔ bank statement — no gap months

tasks.label: Debtors (receivables) reconciliation
tasks.doTxt: Match customer ledgers. Prepare ageing; list disputed and very old balances.
tasks.reconcile: Debtor ledger ↔ customer's statement or written confirmation

tasks.label: Creditors (payables) reconciliation
tasks.doTxt: Match supplier ledgers and hold-backs. Note debit notes and rate differences.
tasks.reconcile: Creditor ledger ↔ supplier statement; purchases ↔ GSTR-2B if GST-registered

tasks.label: Loans, EMI & interest
tasks.doTxt: Match every loan balance. Split EMI into interest and principal correctly.
tasks.reconcile: Loan ledger ↔ lender statement / sanction letter

tasks.label: Statutory dues ledgers
tasks.doTxt: Verify GST payable, TDS payable, PF/ESI payable balances against what was actually deposited.
tasks.reconcile: Dues ledgers ↔ paid challans and portal balances

tasks.label: Related-party & inter-branch balances
tasks.doTxt: Match balances with sister concerns, directors and branches; document the nature of each balance.
tasks.dont: Do not net off related-party balances without written confirmation from both sides.

tasks.label: Stock register up to date
tasks.doTxt: Post every purchase into stock (with GRN where used) and every sale out of stock, item-wise.
tasks.reconcile: Purchases ↔ goods inward ↔ stock register

tasks.label: Physical stock verification
tasks.doTxt: Match book stock with physical count for key items; record shortages/excess with reasons.
tasks.reconcile: Stock register ↔ physical count sheet, signed by the client

tasks.label: Stock valuation — consistent method
tasks.doTxt: Value closing stock at cost or NRV, lower of the two; keep FIFO/weighted-average consistent.
tasks.dont: Do not change the valuation method between months to manage profit.

tasks.label: Goods movement vs e-way bills
tasks.doTxt: Check sales and stock transfers against e-way bills raised.
tasks.reconcile: Stock out ↔ sales invoices ↔ e-way bill portal

tasks.label: Purchase returns & debit notes
tasks.doTxt: Record returns, rate differences and scheme credits with proper debit/credit notes.
tasks.dont: Do not adjust returns directly in purchase entries without a document.

tasks.label: Product-wise margin summary
tasks.doTxt: Prepare a simple item/category-wise gross margin view for the MIS — owners decide from this.

tasks.label: Ledger scrutiny
tasks.doTxt: Scan each ledger for wrong postings, duplicates and round-off differences.
tasks.dont: Do not leave suspense — bring it to zero or explain every item in writing.

tasks.label: Fixed asset register & depreciation
tasks.doTxt: Update the FA register for additions/deletions; check depreciation rates and put-to-use dates.
tasks.dont: Do not expense capital items — repairs vs capitalisation must be judged item by item.

tasks.label: Tax ledgers match filed returns
tasks.doTxt: Ensure GST and TDS ledgers in books agree with what was actually filed and paid.
tasks.reconcile: TDS ledger ↔ 26AS and challans; GST ledgers ↔ GST portal

tasks.label: Revenue & expense cut-off
tasks.doTxt: Check the last few invoices/bills of the month and the first few of the next — right period, right month.
tasks.dont: Do not book next month's invoices this month to inflate sales.

tasks.label: Trial balance & the five key numbers
tasks.doTxt: Tally the trial balance. Re-check sales, profit, cash, receivables and payables against last month and know why each moved.

tasks.doTxt: Get a separate user ID on Tally/Zoho. Note what access was given, by whom, on what date.
tasks.dont: Never take passwords on WhatsApp or personal chat.

tasks.label: Day-1 health check before any entry
tasks.doTxt: Check opening balances against the last closed year. List pending months of bank reco and unfiled returns.
tasks.dont: Do not start entries before this check — old errors will look like yours.

tasks.label: Collect and file source documents

tasks.reconcile: Documents received ↔ the papers list the client confirmed on the portal

tasks.label: Post purchases
tasks.doTxt: Enter every purchase from the vendor bill — correct ledger, correct GST treatment.
tasks.dont: No entry without a bill. Never dump items into 'Miscellaneous'.

tasks.label: Post sales with invoice serial control
tasks.doTxt: Enter sales serial-wise from the invoice register. Flag missing or duplicate invoice numbers to the client.
tasks.reconcile: Sales in books ↔ e-invoice portal / GSTR-1 filings, and bank credits

tasks.label: Post expenses & payments
tasks.doTxt: Book expenses with supporting bills. Move personal spends to drawings/capital.
tasks.dont: Do not guess a ledger — park unclear items in a numbered query list and ask in one batch.

tasks.label: Record cash transactions
tasks.doTxt: Update the cash book date-wise. Verify cash never goes negative on any date.
tasks.reconcile: Cash book ↔ physical cash count, same day

tasks.label: Month-end adjustment entries
tasks.doTxt: Book prepaid expenses, outstanding expenses, accrued income and depreciation for the month.
tasks.dont: Do not leave adjustments for year-end — monthly books must stand on their own.

tasks.label: Bank reconciliation — every account, every month
tasks.doTxt: Match every bank line. Prepare BRS with each difference explained in writing.
tasks.dont: Do not carry unexplained differences forward.
tasks.reconcile: Bank book ↔ bank statement — no gap months

tasks.label: Debtors (receivables) reconciliation
tasks.doTxt: Match customer ledgers. Prepare ageing; list disputed and very old balances.
tasks.reconcile: Debtor ledger ↔ customer's statement or written confirmation

tasks.label: Creditors (payables) reconciliation
tasks.doTxt: Match supplier ledgers and hold-backs. Note debit notes and rate differences.
tasks.reconcile: Creditor ledger ↔ supplier statement; purchases ↔ GSTR-2B if GST-registered

tasks.label: Loans, EMI & interest
tasks.doTxt: Match every loan balance. Split EMI into interest and principal correctly.
tasks.reconcile: Loan ledger ↔ lender statement / sanction letter

tasks.label: Statutory dues ledgers
tasks.doTxt: Verify GST payable, TDS payable, PF/ESI payable balances against what was actually deposited.
tasks.reconcile: Dues ledgers ↔ paid challans and portal balances

tasks.label: Related-party & inter-branch balances
tasks.doTxt: Match balances with sister concerns, directors and branches; document the nature of each balance.
tasks.dont: Do not net off related-party balances without written confirmation from both sides.

tasks.label: Ledger scrutiny
tasks.doTxt: Scan each ledger for wrong postings, duplicates and round-off differences.
tasks.dont: Do not leave suspense — bring it to zero or explain every item in writing.

tasks.label: Fixed asset register & depreciation
tasks.doTxt: Update the FA register for additions/deletions; check depreciation rates and put-to-use dates.
tasks.dont: Do not expense capital items — repairs vs capitalisation must be judged item by item.
